persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayabhūpatīndramalladeva sana cūkavāsadevapratiṣṭhā siddhāgniayutāhutiyajñayāṅāyā thva saṃphuli

notes: The manuscript was copied for the performance of the consecration of courtyard deities and the siddhāgni ayutāhuti sacrifice by King Jayabhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur.
